news_items.title: Bassett Furniture bets on ecommerce amid sales slump
news_items.summary: Bassett Furniture is focusing on ecommerce and omnichannel strategies to counter a 16.7% sales decline in FY 2024. The company has overhauled its ecommerce site, resulting in a 27% increase in online orders, and plans to leverage digital channels for growth.
news_items.relevance_reason: Highlights digital transformation and ecommerce growth, crucial for AI visual content companies.
key_insights: Bassett experienced a 16.7% sales decline in FY 2024.
The company is closing its Noa Home online business.
A late-2023 ecommerce site overhaul led to a 27% increase in online orders.
